svg.aria-label: Eight projects, newest first. V.O.I.C.E., JUL 2026: Desktop agent that reads the screen through a numbered coordinate grid and acts on a spoken command. Built with Python · Gemini Vision · PyAutoGUI. Vantage Hub, MAY 2026: IoT energy system that reconstructs current and voltage waveforms per appliance and forecasts the bill. Built with Flutter · ESP32-S3 · FreeRTOS · scikit-learn. LogicLoom, MAY 2026: Chat platform with an input guardian for jailbreaks and an output guardian for prompt leaks. Built with Flask · LangChain · Groq · MySQL. Live and reachable. ISS Overhead, APR 2026: Tracks the space station every five seconds and emails you on a double opt-in when it passes over. Built with Next.js · TypeScript · FastAPI · Supabase. Live and reachable. Due Desk, OCT 2025: Deadline tracker with priority tagging and automated email reminders. Built with Firebase · Firestore · Nodemailer. Live and reachable. Smart Agent, OCT 2025: Token-streaming assistant. The first thing I deployed, and where the safety pattern started. Built with JavaScript · LLM APIs. Live and reachable. Build My Week, AUG 2025: Drag-and-drop weekly planner with image export, written without a framework. Built with Vanilla JS · CSS. Live and reachable. Universal Sync: Delta-based real-time sync across Android and desktop JVM from a single codebase. Built with Kotlin Multiplatform · Compose · Supabase · Ktor.
svg.text: NEWEST FIRST · EVERY VISUAL BUILT FOR ITS OWN PROJECT
